sources: Sedgwick County Lake Afton Park pages (the live site answers a 'testing whether you are a human visitor' captcha to plain HTTP, so read via Wayback), read 2026-11-06:

Park home, Wayback 2026-07-08 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260708195928/https://www.sedgwickcounty.org/parks/lake-afton-park/): 'Lake Afton Park offers 720 acres ... The 258-acre lake provides boating, water skiing, fishing, and swimming opportunities. Camping facilities include both RV and tent sites with all the expected amenities and more.' 'please call the Lake Afton 316-660-1780.'

Park Fees, Wayback 2026-03-13 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260313073446/https://www.sedgwickcounty.org/parks/lake-afton-park/park-fees/): 'Fees for a Lake Afton camping permit purchased at the park office or at the self-pay station': Regular / 'Senior Rate - 62 and older & Military' - Primitive Camp (no electricity or water) $13.00/day, $76.00/week / $12.00, $69.00; Electric Hook-up $17.00/day, $104.00/week / $15.00, $90.00; Electric & Water $19.50/day, $119.00/week / $17.50, $105.00; 'An additional $5.00/day fee will be assessed for Camping permits purchased from park security.' 'Water hook-ups are available at only 16 sites'

Boating, Camping, and Fishing, Wayback 2026-05-10 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260510055825/https://www.sedgwickcounty.org/parks/lake-afton-park/boating-camping-and-fishing/): 'Open shelters with or without electrical outlets are strategically located throughout the park. Primitive camping is also available in many locations.' 'Campers are allowed to stay in one camping area for 14 days; after that, you must move to another camping area or vacate the park for at least seven days.' 'Generators are not allowed.'

Park Rules (updated June 21, 2024), Wayback 2026-06-18 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260618054505/https://www.sedgwickcounty.org/parks/lake-afton-park/park-rules/): 'You must purchase a park permit in advance to camp'; 'Campers must vacate the park for five consecutive days after camping for 14 consecutive days'; 'limited to 56 total days of camping per single calendar year'; 'You must have a current camping permit obtained by the Lake Afton Park Office, security, or Kiosk machine.'; 'If you camp near one of the rentable shelters, check with the park office before establishing your campsite. Those renting the shelter might have reserved those sites.'; 'Operating a vehicle more than 1 1/2 tons is prohibited unless operated by request of the county.'

Amenities, Wayback 2026-03-14 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260314061900/https://www.sedgwickcounty.org/parks/lake-afton-park/amenities/): 'Seven restroom facilities ( three open during the winter months)'; 'A recreational vehicle sanitation disposal facility'

Park map PDF, Wayback 2025-08-03 (https://web.archive.org/web/20250803042110if_/https://www.sedgwickcounty.org/media/14917/aftonmap.pdf; live copy captcha-walled): 'Recreational Vehicle Parking' symbols at Fisherman's Cove by the observatory, at Shelter #5 on Fellowship Cove and by Cottonwood Grove; Water and Non-Potable Water symbols; one Dump Station

RV Life reviews (park 13104), read 2026-11-06: 5/2025 motorhome site 25 '$17 USD a night' ('be sure to find and stop at the office to pay for your camping permit'); 7/2024 '$17 per night for electric only. Electric and water sites were also available for additional cost. Sites all around lake with great views and easy access to water.'; 3/2024 '$13 ... Military' ('there are several long term campers in the park'); 8/2023 'maintenance might take 2 months for the shower to be fixed'

values.note: Sedgwick County camping permit, bought at the park office or self-pay kiosk: electric $17 a day ($104 a week), electric and water $19.50 ($119 a week; only 16 sites have water); primitive with no hookups $13 ($76 a week). Seniors 62+ and military pay $15 / $17.50 / $12. Add $5 a day if the permit is bought from park security.

values.note: No camping reservations: buy the camping permit at the park office or the self-pay kiosk ($5 more a day from park security). 14 consecutive days, then leave for 5 days (the rules) or 7 (the camping page); 56 days a year at most. Sites near the rentable shelters may be held for a shelter booking, so ask the office first.

booking.source: Lake Afton Park Rules (June 21, 2024; Wayback 2026-06-18) + Boating, Camping, and Fishing page (Wayback 2026-05-10) + Park Fees page; only shelters book online (ssc.sedgwickcounty.org/shelterrentals). Read 2026-11-06

note: Sedgwick County park, 720 acres around the 258-acre Lake Afton, W of Wichita. RV camping in several areas around the shore (Fisherman's Cove by the observatory, Shelter #5 on Fellowship Cove, Cottonwood Grove), with electric at many sites, water at 16, a dump station and restrooms (three open in winter). No generators. Permits at the park office or kiosk, no reservations; 14 days, then 5 days away, 56 days a year at most. Blue-green algae warnings in summer (call 316-660-1780). --Claude
summary: County pages (via Wayback; live site captcha-walled): fees $17/$19.50 confirmed with senior/military rates (discounts.military added); booking reservable true -> false (permits at office/kiosk, only shelters book online), FCFS, 14-day max confirmed plus the 56-day annual cap; dump/potable water confirmed; showers only camper-reported; amperage and site count stated nowhere. Lakeview stands.
flags: BOOKING CHANGE: the stored 'reservable: true' (from my own earlier note, 'Reservable online') isn't supported. The county sells camping permits at the park office, self-pay kiosk or security; the only online booking is for shelters (https://ssc.sedgwickcounty.org/shelterrentals/park.aspx?id=2).

WEIGHT RULE: the county's June 2024 rule summary says 'Operating a vehicle more than 1 1/2 tons is prohibited unless operated by request of the county.' Read literally, that bars EKKO (about 4.75 tons empty) and every motorhome, which can't be the intent at a park with RV electric sites and a 45-ft Class A in the reviews. It probably targets trucks. Flag for AWH; I didn't treat it as a drop.

LONG-TERM CAMPERS: a 3/2024 RV Life camper wrote 'there are several long term campers in the park, evidenced by the junk around', and an 8/2023 camper paid a 'Monthly' discount. But the county caps any camper at 14 consecutive days and 56 days a year and sells permits by the day, so this isn't a mostly-seasonal park.

SHOWERS kept true but only as camper-reported (8/2023 'the shower to be fixed'); the county lists 'Seven restroom facilities' and doesn't say showers. RV Life has a 2.5-star rating from 12; campers report broken bathrooms ('Bathrooms are usually a wreck', 7/2023).

WATERFRONT 'lakeview' stands: camping is dispersed by the shelters around the shore and a 7/2024 camper wrote 'Sites all around lake with great views and easy access to water'. The county's map doesn't draw individual sites, so I couldn't judge any site for lakefront; there's no evidence for an upgrade.

PIN 37.61978,-97.62326 is the MacArthur Rd / S 247th St W intersection at the lake's NE corner, not a camping area. The camping is spread over three map 'RV' areas: Fisherman's Cove by the observatory north of MacArthur Rd, Shelter #5 on Fellowship Cove (east shore), and Cottonwood Grove (west shore). I couldn't place the RV symbols precisely on imagery, so I'm not proposing a move.
